regulatory.name: Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for the safety of machinery, covering automated moving parts and overall system safety.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Entire automated vertical farm system including pumps, HVAC, and automated dosing equipment.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires risk assessment for operator safety during planting/harvesting, guarding of moving parts, and emergency stop provision.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UK Declaration of Conformity and comprehensive technical file.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct ISO 12100 risk assessment for operator interactions with the automated systems.

regulatory.name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for low-voltage electrical equipment safety.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — All low-voltage electrical equipment (LEDs, pumps, AHU, control panels) operating between 50-1000V AC.
regulatory.designImpact: Mandates safe integration of 400V 3-phase supply, preventing electric shock in a wet/damp hydroponic environment.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UKCA mark on the system, supported by LV test reports.
regulatory.gapAction: Compile electrical safety test reports for all integrated mains-voltage components.

regulatory.name: Requirements for Electrical Installations (IET Wiring Regulations)
regulatory.summary: UK wiring regulations for the fixed installation within the container.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Internal low-voltage wiring, distribution board, and 3-phase 400V mains connection; de facto enforcement of EAWR 1989.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires 30 mA Type-A RCDs per circuit, IP54/IP67 ratings for wet environments, and proper earthing.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Electrical Installation Certificate (EIC) signed by a competent person.
regulatory.gapAction: Design internal distribution per BS 7671 and engage qualified electrician to produce EIC after installation.

regulatory.name: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for safe electrical systems in the workplace.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Operation and maintenance of the electrical installation by farm workers.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires safe isolation points (lock-off) for maintenance of pumps, LEDs, and HVAC.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Provision of isolation switches and maintenance safety manual.
regulatory.gapAction: Incorporate lockable isolators into the electrical design for all serviceable equipment.

regulatory.name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for electromagnetic emissions and immunity.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — LED drivers, PLC, IoT gateway, and variable speed drives for pumps/HVAC.
regulatory.designImpact: Must not emit excessive electromagnetic interference and must be immune to external grid noise.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: EMC test report and UK DoC inclusion.
regulatory.gapAction: Identify EMC test house and schedule system-level emissions and immunity testing.

regulatory.name: Food Safety Act 1990
regulatory.summary: Primary UK legislation governing food safety and consumer protection.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Production of leafy greens, herbs, and brassicas for human consumption.
regulatory.designImpact: All surfaces in contact with plants or nutrient water must not contaminate the food with toxic substances.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Food safety hazard analysis (HACCP plan) for the system design.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft initial HACCP plan identifying potential chemical and biological contamination risks.

regulatory.name: Regulation (EC) No 852/2004 on the hygiene of foodstuffs
regulatory.summary: Statutory hygiene requirements for primary food production.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Hygiene of foodstuffs during primary production in the container.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires cleanable surfaces (food-grade FRP/uPVC), pest exclusion, and hygienic drainage (captive spill pan).
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Design compliance statement enabling the operator to register as a food business.
regulatory.gapAction: Review internal lining and drainage design to ensure all surfaces are smooth, washable, and pest-proof.

regulatory.name: Food processing machinery — Basic concepts — Part 2: Hygiene requirements
regulatory.summary: Designated standard for hygienic design of food processing machinery.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Nutrient tanks, pipework, and grow trays; supports Machinery Regs.
regulatory.designImpact: Nutrient tanks, pipework, and grow trays must be smooth, washable, and free of dead legs where pathogens could multiply.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Hygienic design review report and material food-contact declarations.
regulatory.gapAction: Audit plumbing and reservoir design to eliminate dead legs and verify food-grade material specifications.

regulatory.name: Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for plumbing systems connected to the public water supply to prevent contamination.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Connection of the farm's potable water feed to the mains supply.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires a Type AA air gap or WRAS-approved backflow prevention device at the hand-wash sink and nutrient reservoir fill point.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: WRAS approval certificates for all mains-connected valves and fittings.
regulatory.gapAction: Specify WRAS-approved backflow prevention devices for the mains water inlet and sink.

regulatory.name: Fluorinated Greenhouse Gases Regulations 2015
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for the containment, use, and recovery of fluorinated greenhouse gases.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — HVAC/AHU system using R32 or R454B refrigerants.
regulatory.designImpact: System must be designed to prevent leaks, and if charge exceeds CO2 equivalent thresholds, requires leak detection.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: F-Gas logbook and commissioning certificate from an F-Gas registered engineer.
regulatory.gapAction: Confirm refrigerant charge volume and specify leak detection if required by CO2 equivalent thresholds.

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — Specification and testing — Part 1: General cargo containers for general purposes
regulatory.summary: Container structural certification under CSC; becomes invalid once container shell is structurally modified.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — Shipping container enclosure; the original CSC plate is voided once the shell is structurally modified (vents, doors, mains inlets).
regulatory.designImpact: Original CSC plate voided; design must rely on alternative structural certification for road haulage if lifting points or structural integrity are altered.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Structural assessment or payload distribution calculation for flatbed transport.
regulatory.gapAction: Commission structural analysis of the modified container to ensure safe lifting and transport on flatbed lorries.

regulatory.name: Radio Equipment Regulations 2017
regulatory.summary: Statutory framework for equipment that intentionally emits or receives radio waves.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — IoT gateway with 4G/Ethernet uplink and LoRa sensor mesh nodes.
regulatory.designImpact: Wireless transmitters must use approved UK spectrum bands and meet RF safety limits.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: RED test reports for the wireless modules and UK DoC.
regulatory.gapAction: Verify that all selected wireless modules (4G, LoRa) have valid UK/CE RED certification.

regulatory.name: Biocidal Products Regulation (GB BPR)
regulatory.summary: Statutory regulation of biocidal products to protect human health and the environment.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — UV steriliser and any chemical dosing used to treat the recirculating nutrient water.
regulatory.designImpact: Any chemical disinfectants specified for the system must be approved for use in GB; UV system must be sized for effective pathogen kill.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Operating manual specifying BPR-compliant cleaning/dosing agents.
regulatory.gapAction: Ensure any recommended nutrient system cleaning chemicals are registered under GB BPR.

regulatory.name: Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for the safe design and operation of pressure systems.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — CO2 dosing cylinders (47L industrial bottles at high pressure).
regulatory.designImpact: Requires secure mounting, appropriate pressure regulators, and safety relief valves to prevent overpressurisation of the dosing lines.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Written Scheme of Examination (WSE) for the pressure system if applicable, or UKCA marked regulators.
regulatory.gapAction: Specify UKCA-marked CO2 regulators and design secure cylinder restraints for the service vestibule.

regulatory.name: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies
regulatory.summary: Designated standard for low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Main distribution board and control panels; demonstrates compliance with Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations.
regulatory.designImpact: Control panels must be designed for appropriate short-circuit withstand, temperature rise limits, and IP54 protection.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Design verification report or type-test certificate for the control panel assembly.
regulatory.gapAction: Ensure the panel builder provides a BS EN 61439 declaration of conformity for the main distribution board.

regulatory.name: Product Safety and Metrology etc. (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019
regulatory.summary: Umbrella statutory marking for UK market access.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Complete assembled bird feeder; mandatory for placing electrical and radio goods on the GB market.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires compilation of a technical file covering radio, electromagnetic compatibility, hazardous substances, and safety to affix the UKCA mark on the feeder body or packaging.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UK Declaration of Conformity signed by the manufacturer.
regulatory.gapAction: Establish technical file structure to collate all sub-system compliance certificates.

regulatory.name: Radio Equipment Regulations 2017
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirement for products intentionally emitting radio waves.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy, LoRa, and optional cellular modules.
regulatory.designImpact: If using a steel body, a non-metallic radome must be designed to allow RF propagation without exceeding emission limits or causing desense between the 868 MHz and 2.4/5 GHz antennas.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test reports for the integrated system or leveraged modular approvals with documented antenna gain compliance.
regulatory.gapAction: Verify pre-certified module certificates and design RF-transparent radome aperture.

regulatory.name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirement limiting electromagnetic emissions and ensuring immunity.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Neural processing unit, camera module, and power management printed circuit board assembly.
regulatory.designImpact: High-speed compute and 12-megapixel camera data lanes require shielding and layout practices to prevent interference with the onboard radio modules.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test report from a UKAS-accredited laboratory.
regulatory.gapAction: Schedule pre-compliance scanning for the initial printed circuit board prototype.

regulatory.name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: Statutory safety requirements for electrical equipment.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Optional mains-powered variant and general electrical safety principles invoked by the Radio Equipment Regulations for the solar/battery variant.
regulatory.designImpact: Mains adapter must provide isolated low voltage to the outdoor unit; outdoor unit must maintain IP54/IP65 ingress protection to prevent short circuits.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Low voltage safety test report.
regulatory.gapAction: Select a pre-certified mains adapter for the optional variant and define IP sealing strategy for the enclosure.

regulatory.name: Audio/video, information and communication technology equipment - Part 1: Safety requirements
regulatory.summary: Hazard-based safety standard for information and communication technology equipment.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates compliance with the safety objectives of the Radio Equipment Regulations for the camera and compute hardware.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires hazard-based engineering for the battery charging circuit, thermal management of the compute module, and outdoor enclosure flammability ratings.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: CB Scheme certificate or UKAS lab test report against BS EN 62368-1.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct a hazard-based safety engineering review of the solar charge controller and battery placement.

regulatory.name: Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2022
regulatory.summary: Mandatory cybersecurity requirements for consumer connectable products.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Wi-Fi/cellular connected feeder and companion app.
regulatory.designImpact: Prohibits default passwords; requires a vulnerability disclosure policy and a defined minimum support period for security updates for the device firmware.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Statement of Compliance with PSTI requirements accompanying the product.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft vulnerability disclosure policy and implement unique per-device initialisation credentials.

regulatory.name: Data Protection Act 2018
regulatory.summary: Statutory privacy and data protection regime.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Camera capturing video/audio in residential settings, companion app user data, and citizen-science data sharing.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires privacy-by-design: local processing of video reduces cloud data exposure; explicit user consent flows required for data sharing and app highlight reels.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Data Privacy Impact Assessment and published privacy policy.
regulatory.gapAction: Complete a Data Privacy Impact Assessment focusing on incidental capture of neighbours' property and audio recording.

regulatory.name: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, sub-section 38.3
regulatory.summary: Mandatory transport safety tests for lithium batteries.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Lithium iron phosphate battery transport via road, sea, or air.
regulatory.designImpact: Battery pack must withstand altitude, thermal cycling, vibration, shock, and short-circuit testing without rupture or fire.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test summary report from the battery pack manufacturer.
regulatory.gapAction: Request test summary from the shortlisted cell/pack vendor.

regulatory.name: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells
regulatory.summary: Safety standard for lithium batteries in portable/consumer applications.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Battery pack safety; supports General Product Safety Regulations compliance.
regulatory.designImpact: Pack must include a management system with overcharge, deep discharge, and thermal protection, especially given the outdoor UK temperature envelope.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test report and certificate for the specific battery pack.
regulatory.gapAction: Ensure battery specification mandates certification from the supplier.

regulatory.name: Restriction of the Use of Certain Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2012
regulatory.summary: Restricts heavy metals and specific chemicals in electronics.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — All electronic components, camera module, solar panel, and wiring.
regulatory.designImpact: Component selection must strictly exclude lead, cadmium, mercury, and specific phthalates; requires lead-free soldering processes.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Declaration of conformity supported by supplier material declarations.
regulatory.gapAction: Implement a bill of materials scrubbing process to verify compliance for all electronic components.

regulatory.name: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013
regulatory.summary: Producer responsibility for electronic waste disposal and recycling.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — End-of-life disposal of the complete feeder unit.
regulatory.designImpact: Product must be marked with the crossed-out wheelie bin symbol; design should facilitate disassembly of the battery and electronics from the ceramic/steel body.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Registration with a UK Producer Compliance Scheme.
regulatory.gapAction: Register with a compliance scheme before placing the product on the market.

regulatory.name: Waste Batteries and Accumulators Regulations 2009
regulatory.summary: Producer responsibility for battery recycling.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — The integrated lithium iron phosphate battery.
regulatory.designImpact: Battery must be removable by the end-user or a qualified professional at end-of-life; capacity and chemistry must be clearly marked.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Registration with a UK Battery Compliance Scheme.
regulatory.gapAction: Design the battery compartment for accessible end-of-life removal and register with a compliance scheme.

regulatory.name: General Product Safety Regulations 2005
regulatory.summary: Baseline consumer safety requirement for products not fully covered by specific regulations.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Mechanical safety of the ceramic/steel body, modular seed reservoirs, and perches.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires elimination of sharp edges on the steel body, safe failure modes for ceramic, and non-toxic finishes for bird safety.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Product risk assessment documenting mechanical and chemical hazard mitigation.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct a mechanical risk assessment focusing on ceramic breakage and steel edge finishing.

regulatory.name: Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
regulatory.summary: Regulates the use of the radio spectrum in the UK.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — LoRa 868 MHz mesh, Wi-Fi, and optional cellular transmissions.
regulatory.designImpact: LoRa module must adhere to UK industrial, scientific, and medical band duty cycle limits to prevent spectrum abuse.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Firmware documentation proving duty cycle enforcement.
regulatory.gapAction: Configure media access control layer to strictly enforce UK 868 MHz duty cycle limitations.

regulatory.name: Medical Devices Regulations 2002
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for medical devices.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — The walking stick is classed as a Class I medical device (mobility aid with safety features) with a planned upgrade to Class IIa.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires compilation of a technical file, clinical evaluation of the gait analysis and fall detection claims, and post-market surveillance procedures.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UKCA Declaration of Conformity for Class I Medical Device.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft intended use statement and compile Class I technical file.

regulatory.name: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency Device Registration
regulatory.summary: Mandatory registration for medical devices placed on the GB market.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Required for the walking stick before it can be legally sold as a mobility aid in the UK.
regulatory.designImpact: Administrative requirement; enforces strict adherence to the intended use claims.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: MHRA Device Registration Confirmation Letter.
regulatory.gapAction: Create MHRA account and register the Sentinel as a Class I device.

regulatory.name: Medical devices — Quality management systems — Requirements for regulatory purposes
regulatory.summary: Quality management standard for medical device manufacturers.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates QMS compliance under UK MDR 2002 for the design and manufacture of the walking stick.
regulatory.designImpact: Forces strict design controls, traceability of the carbon-fibre shaft and electronic components, and formal verification/validation of the fall detection algorithm.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: ISO 13485 QMS Certificate from a UKAS-accredited Approved Body.
regulatory.gapAction: Implement phase-gate design controls and document the product requirements specification.

regulatory.name: Medical devices — Application of risk management to medical devices
regulatory.summary: Risk management framework for medical devices.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates risk management compliance under UK MDR 2002 for the physical and software risks of the stick.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires mitigation of false-negative fall detections, structural failure of the carbon-fibre shaft, and battery thermal runaway.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Risk Management Report and Hazard Traceability Matrix.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct initial Failure Mode and Effects Analysis on the mechanical structure and fall-detection classifier.

regulatory.name: Assistive products for walking manipulated by one arm — Requirements and test methods — Part 1: Elbow crutches
regulatory.summary: Structural testing standard for one-armed mobility aids.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates mechanical safety compliance under UK MDR 2002 for the carbon-fibre shaft and telescoping joint.
regulatory.designImpact: Shaft, telescoping twist-lock/button, and handle must withstand specified static and dynamic fatigue loads for a 100 kg user rating.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Mechanical test report from an accredited laboratory.
regulatory.gapAction: Build mechanical prototypes of the carbon-fibre shaft and joint to perform physical load testing.

regulatory.name: Radio Equipment Regulations 2017
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for products containing radio transmitters.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the LTE-M/NB-IoT cellular module and GPS receiver embedded in the upper shaft.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires RF testing of the final assembly, ensuring the carbon-fibre shaft does not cause non-compliant emissions or detune the antenna beyond limits.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UKCA Declaration of Conformity referencing RED 2017.
regulatory.gapAction: Review Nordic nRF9160 modular certification and scope delta testing for the final stick assembly.

regulatory.name: Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2022
regulatory.summary: Mandatory cybersecurity requirements for UK consumer connectable products.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the cellular-connected walking stick and its companion app ecosystem.
regulatory.designImpact: Prohibits default passwords on the device, requires a published vulnerability disclosure policy, and mandates a stated minimum security update period for the nRF9160 firmware.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Statement of Compliance with the PSTI Act.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft vulnerability disclosure policy and define the guaranteed firmware support window.

regulatory.name: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells
regulatory.summary: Safety standard for lithium-ion batteries in portable applications.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates compliance with the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 for the custom tubular Li-ion battery.
regulatory.designImpact: Battery pack must include a PCM/BMS for over/under-charge, short circuit, and thermal protection, and pass crush/drop/thermal abuse tests.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: IEC 62133-2 test report and certificate from the battery pack manufacturer.
regulatory.gapAction: Request IEC 62133-2 certification from the custom tubular battery supplier.

regulatory.name: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, sub-section 38.3
regulatory.summary: Mandatory transport safety tests for lithium batteries.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the transport of the lithium-ion battery inside the walking stick via road, sea, or air.
regulatory.designImpact: Battery must survive altitude simulation, thermal cycling, vibration, and shock without rupture or thermal runaway.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UN 38.3 Test Summary Report.
regulatory.gapAction: Obtain UN 38.3 test summary from the battery vendor before authorising first shipment.

regulatory.name: Household and similar electrical appliances — Safety — Part 1: General requirements
regulatory.summary: Safety standard for mains-powered household appliances.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Demonstrates compliance with the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 for the mains-powered inductive charging stand.
regulatory.designImpact: Charging stand must provide adequate isolation from mains voltage, use flame-retardant plastics, and prevent overheating during inductive power transfer.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test report from a UKAS-accredited lab demonstrating compliance with BS EN 60335-1.
regulatory.gapAction: Design charging stand PCBA with appropriate creepage/clearance and select UL94 V-0 enclosure materials.

regulatory.name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: UK statutory framework for electromagnetic emissions and immunity.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the walking stick's electronics and the inductive charging stand.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires the stick to withstand ±4 kV contact ESD and ensures the inductive charger does not emit excessive radiated noise.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: EMC test report to EN 61000 series.
regulatory.gapAction: Book pre-compliance EMC testing, specifically focusing on ESD strikes to the capacitive grip sensor and handle.

regulatory.name: UK General Data Protection Regulation
regulatory.summary: Statutory framework for the processing of personal data.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the collection, transmission, and storage of the user's location and health data.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires end-to-end encryption of cellular payloads, explicit user consent mechanisms in the companion app, and secure data routing to the alarm receiving centre.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Data Protection Impact Assessment and published Privacy Policy.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft DPIA mapping the data flow from the nRF9160 module to the alarm receiving centre servers and family app.

regulatory.name: Restriction of the Use of Certain Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2012
regulatory.summary: Restricts hazardous materials in electronic products.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to all electronic components, PCBs, and solders within the walking stick and charging stand.
regulatory.designImpact: Mandates the use of lead-free solder and RoHS-compliant components.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: RoHS Declaration of Conformity supported by supplier material declarations.
regulatory.gapAction: Compile a RoHS compliance roll-up in the Bill of Materials.

regulatory.name: Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013
regulatory.summary: Mandates producer responsibility for electronic waste disposal.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the end-of-life disposal of the walking stick and charging stand.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires the product to be marked with the crossed-out wheelie bin symbol and designed for battery removability at end-of-life.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Registration with a UK WEEE Producer Compliance Scheme.
regulatory.gapAction: Register with a WEEE compliance scheme prior to placing the product on the UK market.

regulatory.name: Requirements for Connection of Generation Equipment in Parallel with Public Distribution Networks above 16A
regulatory.summary: Mandatory UK grid code for behind-the-meter storage connecting in parallel with the distribution network; requires grid-forming capability and compliance with ESQCR.
regulatory.applicability: UK approved code — Grid connection point >16 A behind-the-meter; ENA G99 is the Engineering Recommendation enforced by every DNO, sitting under ESQCR.
regulatory.designImpact: Inverter must support grid-forming mode, islanding detection, and specified frequency/voltage ride-through parameters.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: G99 commissioning test record signed by host DNO, generation connection agreement.
regulatory.gapAction: Engage Distribution Network Operator to submit G99 application and schedule commissioning witness test.

regulatory.name: Electrical energy storage (EES) systems — Part 5-2: Safety requirements for grid-integrated EES systems
regulatory.summary: UKCA harmonised standard for stationary battery energy storage safety; replaces US UL 9540 for UK market access.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Complete BESS enclosure + integration; demonstrates compliance with the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 + UKCA marking under the Low Voltage scheme.
regulatory.designImpact: System must pass specified fire propagation, thermal runaway, and containment tests; dictates ventilation, fire detection/suppression integration.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test report from UKAS-accredited lab demonstrating compliance with BS EN IEC 62933-5-2.
regulatory.gapAction: Identify UKAS-accredited test house and scope testing programme for system-level safety.

regulatory.name: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements for secondary lithium cells and batteries, for use in industrial applications
regulatory.summary: Safety requirements for the LFP cells and battery modules.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — LFP cells and modules; demonstrates compliance with the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
regulatory.designImpact: Cells must incorporate pressure relief, and BMS must protect against over-voltage, under-voltage, over-current, and over-temperature.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: CB Scheme test certificate and report for the specific LFP cells and modules used.
regulatory.gapAction: Procure IEC 62619 certification pack from the selected cell/module manufacturer.

regulatory.name: Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline or other non-acid electrolytes - Safety requirements for secondary lithium cells and batteries for use in electrical energy storage systems
regulatory.summary: Specific safety standard for lithium batteries in stationary energy storage.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Battery racks and system-level battery integration; demonstrates compliance with the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
regulatory.designImpact: Dictates electrical insulation, short-circuit withstand, and mechanical integrity of the battery racks within the container.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Test report and certificate for the integrated battery rack system.
regulatory.gapAction: Ensure integrator provides IEC 63056 compliance documentation for the rack assemblies.

regulatory.name: Requirements for Electrical Installations (IET Wiring Regulations)
regulatory.summary: UK wiring regulations for the fixed installation within the BESS container.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Internal low-voltage wiring + protection inside the container; BS 7671 IET Wiring Regulations are the de facto enforcement of the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 (EAWR) for fixed installations.
regulatory.designImpact: Design must comply with shock protection, earthing, overcurrent protection, and isolation requirements; may require RCD protection on auxiliary circuits.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Electrical installation certificate (EIC) signed by a competent person, plus schedule of inspections and test results.
regulatory.gapAction: Design internal distribution per BS 7671 and engage qualified electrician to produce EIC after installation.

regulatory.name: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for electrical safety in the workplace.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Applies to the design, construction, and maintenance of the BESS to prevent danger from electrical shock or burns.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires dead-front panels, lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) provisions, and safe isolation points for the 1.5 MW PCS and DC busbars.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Design risk assessment and safe system of work documentation.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct electrical hazard HAZOP and integrate LOTO points into the DC and AC switchgear design.

regulatory.name: Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: UK statutory regime for low voltage electrical equipment safety.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Umbrella regulation for the LV electrical system (PCS, BMS, auxiliary circuits) requiring UKCA marking.
regulatory.designImpact: Mandates that the equipment is safe, constructed to good engineering practice, and protects against electrical and non-electrical hazards.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UK Declaration of Conformity and technical file.
regulatory.gapAction: Compile technical file including all designated standard test reports to draft the UK DoC.

regulatory.name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: UK statutory regime for EMC.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — PCS, BMS, and SCADA gateway emissions and immunity; requires UKCA marking.
regulatory.designImpact: PCS switching frequencies and BMS communications must be shielded and filtered to prevent grid harmonic distortion and radiated emissions.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: EMC test report and inclusion in the UK Declaration of Conformity.
regulatory.gapAction: Review PCS and BMS supplier EMC test reports to ensure they cover the integrated container environment.

regulatory.name: Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
regulatory.summary: UK statutory regime for machinery safety.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Liquid cooling skid (HVAC/chiller) with moving parts; requires UKCA marking.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires guarding of moving parts, emergency stop integration, and safe maintenance access for the cooling skid.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UK Declaration of Conformity for the HVAC skid and integration risk assessment.
regulatory.gapAction: Verify HVAC supplier provides Machinery Regulations DoC and integrate E-stop into system controller.

regulatory.name: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, Part III, sub-section 38.3 — Lithium metal and lithium ion batteries
regulatory.summary: Mandatory transport safety tests for lithium cells and batteries; required before shipping battery modules.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Battery cells/modules during transport (road/sea/air); UN 38.3 + ADR / Carriage of Dangerous Goods Regulations 2009.
regulatory.designImpact: Cells must pass altitude simulation, thermal cycling, vibration, shock, overcharge, and forced discharge tests.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UN 38.3 test summary report from cell supplier or accredited lab; ADR dangerous goods note for road transport.
regulatory.gapAction: Confirm cell supplier has valid UN 38.3 certification, and prepare ADR documentation for road shipment.

regulatory.name: Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road
regulatory.summary: Regulations governing the transport of dangerous goods by road.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Road transport of the BESS containing Class 9 lithium batteries on a flatbed lorry to the UK site.
regulatory.designImpact: Container and battery packaging must meet ADR requirements for securement, labelling, and emergency information during transit.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: ADR transport documentation, vehicle placarding, and driver ADR training certificate.
regulatory.gapAction: Contract an ADR-certified haulage firm for the flatbed transport and prepare the dangerous goods transport document.

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — Specification and testing — Part 1: General cargo containers for general purposes
regulatory.summary: Container structural certification under CSC; becomes invalid once container shell is structurally modified.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — Shipping container enclosure; the original CSC plate is voided once the shell is structurally modified (vents, large openings, bracing). Re-certification path is alternative structural compliance, not ISO 1496-1.
regulatory.designImpact: Original CSC plate voided; design must rely on alternative structural certification (FEA to EN 1993 or new classification-society inspection) for lifting via the 4 corner castings.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Finite element analysis report or new structural certification under a recognised classification society.
regulatory.gapAction: Commission structural analysis of modified container per design loads and engage classification society for re-certification.

regulatory.name: Standard for the Installation of Stationary Energy Storage Systems
regulatory.summary: US reference standard often cited by UK insurers and NFCC guidance; not statutory in the UK.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — Fire safety design; NFCC Grid Scale BESS Operational Guidance + insurer underwriting reference, NOT UK statute. UK statutory peer for system-level fire safety is BS EN IEC 62933-5-2.
regulatory.designImpact: Spacing (3m separation), fire suppression density, smoke control, and explosion prevention concepts can inform design but UK compliance is via BS EN IEC 62933-5-2.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Not mandated; insurer may request alignment report or justification.
regulatory.gapAction: Review NFPA 855 recommendations and incorporate where they strengthen the fire safety case; prepare statement for insurer if needed.

regulatory.name: Test Method for Evaluating Thermal Runaway Fire Propagation in Battery Energy Storage Systems
regulatory.summary: Industry-standard test method for evaluating thermal runaway propagation.
regulatory.applicability: Insurer best-practice — Thermal runaway fire propagation test method; heavily referenced by NFCC and UK insurers for BESS siting and deflagration vent sizing.
regulatory.designImpact: Dictates the sizing of deflagration panels and validates the effectiveness of the suppression system in preventing module-to-module propagation.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UL 9540A test report at the cell, module, and unit level.
regulatory.gapAction: Request UL 9540A test reports from the battery integrator to provide to the local Authority Having Jurisdiction and site insurer.

regulatory.name: The Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015
regulatory.summary: UK health and safety regulations for construction projects.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Site installation of the 40ft container on the prepared concrete pad and AC tie-in.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires designing out installation risks (e.g., safe lifting points for the 40t container, clear M24/M30 anchorage access).
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Pre-construction information (PCI), construction phase plan (CPP), and health and safety file.
regulatory.gapAction: Appoint a Principal Designer and Principal Contractor for the site preparation and 2-day commissioning window.

regulatory.name: Water Supply (Water Quality) Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: Statutory requirements for the quality of water intended for human consumption in England and Wales.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Potable water output quality and material contact safety for municipal supply.
regulatory.designImpact: Post-treatment remineralisation and chlorination must achieve < 500 mg/L TDS and 0.2-0.5 mg/L free chlorine; all wetted parts must not contaminate water.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Regulation 31 approval or WRAS certification for all wetted components.
regulatory.gapAction: Audit all post-RO wetted materials against Regulation 31 approved lists.

regulatory.name: Suitability of non-metallic materials and products for use in contact with water intended for human consumption with regard to their effect on the quality of the water
regulatory.summary: Testing standard for non-metallic materials to ensure they do not impart odour, flavour, or microbial growth to drinking water.
regulatory.applicability: UK designated standard — Non-metallic materials in contact with potable water (LP piping, RO membranes, FRP vessels); demonstrates compliance with Water Supply Regulations.
regulatory.designImpact: Restricts material selection for UPVC, HDPE, and FRP components to prevent leaching or microbial growth.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: BS 6920 test certificates from material suppliers.
regulatory.gapAction: Collect BS 6920 certificates for all selected plastics, resins, and membranes.

regulatory.name: UK Conformity Assessed Marking
regulatory.summary: Mandatory UK product marking for goods placed on the market in Great Britain.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Umbrella conformity assessment for the complete containerised plant.
regulatory.designImpact: Forces compilation of a technical file covering Machinery, EMC, Electrical Safety, and Pressure Equipment regulations.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: UK Declaration of Conformity and affixed UKCA plate.
regulatory.gapAction: Establish technical file structure and assign regulation owners.

regulatory.name: Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
regulatory.summary: Essential health and safety requirements for machinery.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — High-pressure pump, ERD, and automated dosing skids.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires guarding of rotating pump shafts, emergency stop integration, and safe maintenance access (600-800 mm aisle).
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Machinery risk assessment and incorporation into UKCA technical file.
regulatory.gapAction: Conduct ISO 12100 risk assessment on the pump skid and ERD.

regulatory.name: Pressure Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 (PESR)
regulatory.summary: Safety requirements for the design and manufacture of pressure equipment.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — High-pressure RO vessels (69-83 bar) and Duplex 2205 piping.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires category classification based on pressure-volume (PS x V); dictates welding qualifications, NDT, and 1.5x safety factor.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Approved Body certificate for Category III/IV pressure assemblies.
regulatory.gapAction: Calculate PS x V for the RO rack to determine PESR category and engage Approved Body.

regulatory.name: Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000 (PSSR)
regulatory.summary: Requirements for the safe operation and maintenance of pressure systems.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Installed operation of the 70-bar RO pressure system.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires provision of safe operating limits, pressure relief devices, and inspection access points.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Written Scheme of Examination (WSE) drawn up by a competent person before operation.
regulatory.gapAction: Draft P&ID highlighting pressure relief valves and isolation points for the WSE.

regulatory.name: Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: Limits electromagnetic emissions and ensures immunity to interference.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — 45-75 kW pump motor, VFDs, PLC, and dosing pumps.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires shielded cables for VFDs, proper earthing of the skid, and harmonic mitigation to prevent grid/genset interference.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: EMC test report or technical construction file.
regulatory.gapAction: Specify EMC filters for the 75 kW VFD and detail cable segregation rules.

regulatory.name: Requirements for Electrical Installations (IET Wiring Regulations)
regulatory.summary: UK wiring regulations for fixed electrical installations.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Internal low-voltage wiring, lighting, and control panel distribution inside the container; enforces EAWR 1989.
regulatory.designImpact: Dictates cable sizing, IP65/NEMA 4X panel ratings, RCD protection, and earthing arrangements for wet environments.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Electrical Installation Certificate (EIC).
regulatory.gapAction: Design internal distribution per BS 7671 and engage qualified electrician.

regulatory.name: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 (EAWR)
regulatory.summary: Statutory duties for safe electrical systems in the workplace.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Overall electrical safety of the 380-460 V 3-phase system during operation and maintenance.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires safe isolation points, lock-off facilities for the HP pump, and protection against water ingress.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Standard operating procedures and maintenance manuals.
regulatory.gapAction: Design lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) points for the main incomer and HP pump.

regulatory.name: Series 1 freight containers — Specification and testing — Part 1: General cargo containers for general purposes
regulatory.summary: Container structural certification under CSC.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — Shipping container enclosure; original CSC plate is voided once the shell is structurally modified for louvres, piping penetrations, and doors.
regulatory.designImpact: Original CSC plate voided; design must rely on alternative structural certification for lifting and transport with 18,000 kg operating mass.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Finite element analysis report or new structural certification under a recognised classification society.
regulatory.gapAction: Commission structural analysis of modified container per design loads.

regulatory.name: Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016
regulatory.summary: Regulates discharges to water and the environment.
regulatory.applicability: UK statutory — Discharge of high-salinity brine (20.8 m³/h) and chemical CIP waste to the environment.
regulatory.designImpact: Requires brine dilution strategies or specific outfall designs to minimise local marine ecosystem impact.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Environmental permit or discharge consent from the Environment Agency.
regulatory.gapAction: Model brine dispersion characteristics to support future customer permit applications.

regulatory.name: WHO Guidelines for Drinking-water Quality
regulatory.summary: International norms on water quality and human health.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — International baseline for potable water output (< 500 mg/L TDS), often required by disaster relief agencies and insurers.
regulatory.designImpact: Sets the performance target for the two-pass RO and post-treatment chlorination dosing.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: Water quality laboratory test report during commissioning.
regulatory.gapAction: Define commissioning test protocol to verify TDS and free chlorine levels.

regulatory.name: Drinking Water System Components - Health Effects
regulatory.summary: US standard establishing minimum health effects requirements for materials in contact with drinking water.
regulatory.applicability: Voluntary reference — US standards for drinking water system components and lead-free compliance, specified in the design brief.
regulatory.designImpact: Restricts material selection for all potable-water-contact items (valves, pipes, tanks) to certified components.
regulatory.evidenceRequired: NSF certification marks or supplier declarations for wetted components.
regulatory.gapAction: Verify NSF/ANSI 61 and 372 compliance for the selected permeate piping and chlorination skid.

scores.summary: Good project-mapped matrix with actionable evidence and owners, but it overstates some BS standards as statutory and misses several desalination-specific UK legal interfaces such as abstraction/discharge permits, Water Fittings, LVD, chemicals/COSHH, and site-operation duties.
scores.nextFix: Prompt the engine to classify every entry by legal status — UK statutory instrument, UK designated/harmonised standard, approved code/guidance, insurer/client requirement, or voluntary reference — and to add all product-, installation-, operation-, water-quality-, abstraction-, discharge-, chemical-, transport-, and site-safety obligations specific to a containerised seawater RO plant.
